condition_contraindications.reason: Non-selective beta-blockade prevents beta-2 mediated bronchodilation, creating high risk of acute, life-threatening bronchospasm in patients with reactive airway disease.
condition_contraindications.evidence_source: FDA Inderal Prescribing Information, Section 4: Contraindications.

condition_contraindications.reason: NSAID inhibition of COX-1 impairs gastric mucosal cytoprotection, with documented risk of ulcer perforation and massive hemorrhage.
condition_contraindications.evidence_source: FDA Nonsteroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs Boxed Warning; American College of Gastroenterology Ulcer Guidelines.

condition_contraindications.reason: Methotrexate is a potent dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor causing embryo-fetal death and major congenital malformations (FDA Pregnancy Category X).
condition_contraindications.evidence_source: FDA Trexall Prescribing Information, Boxed Warning: Teratogenicity.

allergy_contraindications.reason: Documented beta-lactam hypersensitivity carries high probability of severe allergic response including anaphylaxis, angioedema, or Stevens-Johnson syndrome.
allergy_contraindications.evidence_source: FDA Amoxil Prescribing Information, Section 4: Contraindications.
